evidence.detail: 2024-05-02: Store Scryfall's oracle_id in cards db — one field from the issue list was added 5 years after filing
highres_image, image_uris, lang, multiverse_ids, released_at (per printing), scryfall_uri are explicitly in the 'parts we don't [store]' section of the card description ABC
card_values only stores id, oracle_id, layout per card; multiverse_ids, lang, highres_image, image_uris absent from INSERT

triage.notes: oracle_id has since been stored (d338d3ee, May 2024); the remaining fields (multiverse_ids, lang, highres_image, image_uris, per-printing released_at/scryfall_uri) each need an owner decision on whether they're worth storing, followed by a schema migration for any that are chosen.
